# Links and images

Inline [text](https://example.com) link.
Titled [text](https://example.com "Example title") link.
Autolink <https://example.com/auto> here.
Reference [text][ref] link and collapsed [ref][] and shortcut [ref].
Image: ![alt text](img/pic.png)
Image with title: ![alt](img/pic.png "Pic title")
Linked image: [![badge](img/badge.svg)](https://example.com/ci)
Footnote reference[^1] in prose.
Bare URL https://example.com/bare is not a link mark.
Brackets [not a link] with no target.
Brackets [not a link] (space before paren) still not a link.
Empty target [text]() and empty text [](https://example.com).

[ref]: https://example.com/ref
[^1]: The footnote definition.
